parsed_json.up: Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value for activity rows against target CHEMBL260. Filter to target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Preserve row multiplicity without DISTINCT. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
